acceptance: candidate and integrate check the destination path and branch before creating anything, and exit non-zero with a message naming the conflicting path or branch.
A failure after creation removes only the worktree and branch this invocation created.
Refresh tests cover an existing destination path, an existing branch, and a failure after the branch is created.
context:
Decision gate: none; the behaviour mirrors what MAINTAINING.md already documents for auto.

Verification rubric: (1) new tests fail before and pass after; (2) reproduce the original crash: in a clean clone with an existing ../sqlglot.refresh-candidate worktree, 'python -m downstream.refresh candidate --tag v30.31.0 --path ../sqlglot.refresh-candidate --branch refresh/candidate-30.31.0' now exits with a clear message and leaves no new branch; (3) downstream test suite passes.

Guardrails: never delete or modify a worktree, directory or branch that existed before the invocation; never force-remove a worktree with uncommitted changes; auto's existing refusal behaviour is unchanged.

Delivered in https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox-sqlglot/pull/90, merged as 19ddf096438b3a9d1ef815bdb6e59473d463939f (20/20 checks passed). 132 downstream tests pass (controller, refresh, contract, delivery, distribution). candidate and integrate share add_worktree: refuse an existing --path or --branch before creating anything, and remove a branch left by a failed git worktree add; main() exits with a message instead of a traceback. Tests: test_candidate_refuses_an_existing_path_or_branch_and_creates_nothing (existing dir kept intact, existing branch untouched, worktree under a file leaves no branch), test_command_line_reports_a_stopped_candidate_without_a_traceback. A candidate stopping on a carried patch keeps its worktree for manual resolution, as documented.
description: Running 'python -m downstream.refresh candidate --tag v30.31.0 --path ../sqlglot.refresh-candidate --branch refresh/candidate-30.31.0' (the MAINTAINING.md example path) in a clean clone, while ../sqlglot.refresh-candidate already held an older candidate worktree, ended in an unhandled subprocess.CalledProcessError from 'git worktree add' (exit 128). The branch refresh/candidate-30.31.0 was left behind at the tag commit, so a rerun fails on the existing branch. MAINTAINING.md says auto refuses to start, removing nothing, when its branch or work directory exists; candidate and integrate have no such pre-check.
